comment: C–N bond formation between W-W on the core peptide WHIW

changelog.comment: New entry. Added missing Tailoring reaction terms and cofactor. Compresseded the reactions descriptions into 1 description.

reactions.description: ScaP installs a C-N cross-link (Trp1-C to Trp4-N) on the motif WHIW of ScaA precursor peptide. The mature product Canumycin, is trimethylated at the free N-terminus of the Trp1 residue by the N-methyltransferase. ScaA: MRKLLRRVTGRRVNRQAWHIW
